additional_info.body:
Hi Furkan,
Thank you for sharing the charger logs.
We have analyzed the data and concluded that there is no issue from the charger side. The charging session was aborted during the cable check, and the source of the interruption appears to be the EV. Additionally, no PLC link was established. The last charging session in the logs you provided was successful.
Please find below the EVCCID that is consistently causing the session to abort
Let me know if you have any further query to discuss if not we shall proceed with closing this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0426633-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003482]DC3/DC4: Charging Phase "P03_CABLE_CHECK" --> "P00_UNKNOWN" CRM:00643001417
additional_info.body:
Hi,
When I check the logs from the last six weeks, I don’t see any successful charging sessions. Furthermore, how could the EVCCID be the cause, since it's just a dot-less version of the EVMAC address? In my opinion, we should focus on the possibility of authentication failures. I will ask from customer to check their OCPP URLs and QR URLs.
Sincerely,
Furkan

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0426633-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003482]DC3/DC4: Charging Phase "P03_CABLE_CHECK" --> "P00_UNKNOWN" CRM:00643001417
additional_info.body:
Hi Furkan,
Thank you for your response.
I know the EVCCID is a dot less version of EV MAC address. The reason I shared the snapshot is that every time the charging session occurred it failed in Cable check phase and the source of that EV, as in the logs shared same MAC address is not being charged. Need to discuss it with customer which vehicle they are trying to charge. As it looks like it got failed in the ContractAuthentication phase and we have the message timeout.
Thank you.

additional_info.subject: 0426633 - ID0426633-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003482]DC3/DC4: Charging Phase "P03_CABLE_CHECK" --> "P00_UNKNOWN" CRM:00472000339
additional_info.body:
Hello Furkan,
After our intervention today we have identified the problem. The installation of dispenser was not done properly.
The DC power cables from outlet 3 and outlet 4 are swapped.
As we can see in the pictures the cables belonging to DC4 marked with one ribbon or two ribbons are connected on A+ and A- instead B+ and B- as is represented on the Electrical Schematic.
This explains why there was no successful charging sessions on outlet 3 and 4 since the commissioning. To fix the issue please proceed to swap the cables connected on A+/A- with B+/B
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
